design.option: (b) small residual head on the frozen WM; option (a) rollout fine-tune NOT implemented (deferred per brief)
design.head: reg_k = gain_k * slog(WM prediction_k) + MLP(observable features, pooled WM latent) for k = synergy, group advantage, best-solo advantage, plus an admission logit; last layer zero-initialised so an untrained head ranks exactly like the current WM; 5-member seed ensemble; WM weights never change
design.loss: Huber(slog synergy) + 0.25 Huber(aux advantages) + pairwise logistic rank loss on synergy + 0.5 BCE(admitted rate)
design.inputs: observable rows of the WM query (fallback: CAV-sensed CONTEXT rows), move family/members/onset/hold/depth, WM mean synergy / saving / best-solo saving / draw std, frozen driver-encoder latent (embedding + params + uncertainty) pooled over members and neighbours; world config labels (cell/demand/penetration/variant/arm) are never inputs
design.labels: per (situation, move, CRN seed identity): seed 1 shared across sources; replicates keyed by salt; dedup priority native all8 > flat examples > probe screens (native admission kept, measured synergy filled); pair target = mean synergy over measured seeds, admitted_any / admitted_rate
design.split: by WORLD seed (sha256-ordered round-robin folds, salt wallfit-w3-split-v1); test = fold 0; plus grouped CV out-of-fold
design.comparison: ONLY the current WM ranking (wm_mean_synergy); no black-box comparator is trained
design.sign_convention: advantage = J(policy) - J(move); synergy = J(best solo) - J(group); positive = group better (veh-s)

seed_and_path_rules: TRAIN worlds only (986000-986071, 987000-987071, 988000-988071 == protocol.worlds('train', i)); any record with 962xxx, 964000-964199, 977xxx or a non-TRAIN seed raises ForbiddenSeedError and nothing is written; directories/files containing holdout/heldout/cal_split/chunk5/j4b/inc1/sealed/hetdata/truth/vehicle_params/driver_params/vtype are pruned before listing and never opened; lowcoop (probe-only HDV variant) and non-120 s windows (wall_ext) excluded by default

tests.result: 33 passed (~55 s, CPU, fakes only; no SUMO/GPU/ssh)
tests.lint: python -m ruff check tools/wallfit: All checks passed
covers: dataset refuses forbidden seeds (results / all8 / flat / context / query / rebuilt query / LABELS load / split) and writes nothing
guard TRAIN blocks == tools.coopmwm.protocol.worlds('train', i); forbidden path tokens refused; forbidden dirs pruned before listing
held-out split is by world seed: deterministic, outcome-blind, disjoint; HEAD_SPLIT train seeds disjoint from test seeds
head at init == WM ranking; trained head on synthetic data: Spearman > 0.5 and > WM + 0.5 on test seeds; precision@3 >= WM

rank API: default OFF output == verbatim probe_wm ranking (also JSON-identical), sort_key == old key, no torch import on the OFF path; ON keeps every WM field and adds head fields; env-var path; mining lane rows
latent extraction on a fake runtime (warm request_memory binding, slot order, no weight change); end-to-end build on a fake cpuV-like probe root (dedup, WM join, job predictions, query rebuild)

caveats: Small data: only ~4 admitted pairs in the probe ledger; the fixed test fold can contain 0 admitted pairs (precision@k then None) - read the out-of-fold CV block; results are diagnostic, not a gate

Real-runtime latent path (tools.wmteach / FULL-v4 warm conditioning) is tested only with a fake runtime; if encode_drivers yields no encoder outputs the code falls back to the driver_encoder module and otherwise records per-query errors (never imputed)
Pairs whose situation comes from CONTEXT rows (no saved WM query) have no latent and slightly different row coverage than at ranking time unless --query-builder is used
Mining bank layouts on gpuA were not inspectable from here; the adapters follow verify_perseed.confirm_all8 / probe_native.extract code and count every skip in BUILD_RECEIPT.json
